decisions.reason: Although this recruitment service is distant from our maritime core, it was only recently launched, has already been publicly committed to on our website, and in an expanding firm we would be inclined to give the invested effort more time and attribute any slow uptake to early-stage market development rather than abandon it immediately.

This superyacht crew recruitment service clearly builds on our established crewing capabilities, fits our stated move toward broader integrated maritime solutions, and the recent public launch makes management likely to continue backing it rather than reverse course after such a short period.
